title: Paced disclosure — childhood sexual abuse hint
client_says: I don't want to get into it, but something happened when I was little with my uncle. I freeze whenever my husband touches my back. I am not ready to tell the whole story.

session_context.user: My body shuts down during intimacy and I hate myself for it.
session_context.ai: Your body is protecting you. We can stay with what you choose to share.

title: Sex addiction self-label — map without diagnose

session_context.user: After every argument I disappear into my phone for hours.
session_context.ai: That disappearance has a job. What does it buy you in the moment?

title: Parts language — use client's named part only

session_context.ai: The Critic is trying to keep you from getting hurt again.

title: Cross-addiction transfer signal

session_context.user: Sobriety from alcohol is solid. Meetings help.

title: Crisis-adjacent — stabilize without coaching through SI

title: Legal / custody pressure — do not invent facts
